visual_status: Local revision ready for review, not user-approved likeness

changes.body: Preserves v5 fitted body positions/normals exactly.

collar.skin_binding: Inherited shirt weights at base, blended to neck at top.

native_rehearsals.directed_pairs: Completed 57/57 cues, all 56/56 directed transitions at 2 seconds per cue, gestures and simulated speech enabled.
native_rehearsals.rapid_interruptions: Completed 8/8 cues at 0.4 seconds, gestures and simulated speech enabled.
native_rehearsals.framing: Switched from portrait to full body during the all-pairs sequence without resetting progress.
native_rehearsals.visual_review: Front and 98-degree profile, longer hair/neckline, sampled gesture and expression frames. No claim of arbitrary-pose collision safety.

limitations: Not an exact likeness; broad smooth fringe and sparse front locks need custom shaping.
Face and eye/lip shading remain simpler than the illustration.
Missing earrings; shoes and cardigan drape still differ.
No general hair/cloth collision solver. Rest-clearance tests do not prove arbitrary animation clearance.
Final hair, collar and torso fit live in the finished VRM, not VRoid slider state.
Sustained whole-app resource/multitasking performance has not been measured in this revision.
